scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a rocky hillside path, a gray-bearded traveler with a staff faces a man in an ochre robe and green cloak holding two donkeys' ropes. Woven baskets on the saddled donkeys hold round loaves, dark raisin clusters, figs and other fruit; a brown leather skin hangs from the nearer load. Warm watercolor hills stretch beneath a blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined hilltop meeting follows the verse's two men, two saddled donkeys and abundant provisions. Only part of each packed load is visible, so the picture does not claim to count the stated quantities. Faces, garments and terrain are illustrative conventions; Mephibosheth is mentioned as Ziba's master and is absent. Ziba's motives are not inferred.
